text: The Tax Court held that the taxpayer failed to substantiate charitable contribution deductions under section 170. Contributions over $250 require a contemporaneous written acknowledgment from the donee organization stating the amount of cash and description of any property other than cash.

Head of household filing status requires that the taxpayer be unmarried or considered unmarried on the last day of the year, pay more than half the cost of keeping up a home for the year, and have a qualifying person live with them for more than half the year.
